cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two fingers, like yours. A name each, then. I'll name who reported you late if you name who reported me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm ordering two coffees. I only know which department.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coffee settled. Then departments for departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. I'll arrange coffee with mine too. Same access, same price.

reason: Copied coffee order becomes mistaken equal-name bargain; B available information and introduction cause matching price changes.
